title: Event-sourced ledger: snapshot+replay and cache diverge from the audit rebuild in specific sequences

hidden_checks.spec: Acceptance criteria repro 1 (288.50 everywhere); rule 1 agreement; rule 2 snapshot correctness.
Acceptance repro 2 (capture succeeds); rule 5: a hold placed before a snapshot can be captured after it through any repository; README HoldNotFound for finished holds.
Acceptance repro 3; rule 6 returns ids as int; rule 1 agreement with the audit.
Acceptance repro 4; rules 5 and 6 (int ids, numeric order, no crash); rule 1.
Acceptance repro 5 (svc2.balance is 7.00, retried deposit through svc2 succeeds); rule 7 caching; rule 1.
Rule 6: ascending numeric hold-id order (2 before 10), ids returned as int; rule 5: events carry int hold_id; README: one batch of HoldReleased.
Rule 5: events read back carry int hold_id; describe()['holds'] keyed by int; hold ids never reused.
Rule 5: a new hold's id is one more than the highest id ever placed; README next id rules; rule 1.
Rule 4: a new repository reads exactly stream_version - latest_snapshot_version events; rule 3 / README: snapshots on every multiple of snapshot_every.
Rule 3: a save that crosses a multiple writes a snapshot at a version reached by that save; rule 4 events_read; rule 2.
Rules 1 and 2 for snapshot_every 1, 2, 3 with multi-event transfer batches and expiry batches.
Rule 8: a stale save raises ConcurrencyError and writes neither events nor snapshots.
Rule 9: snapshots already written by the current code (string hold-id keys) must never produce wrong state; rule 5 capture after snapshot and no id reuse.
Rules 2/3/4 with snapshot_every=1: a snapshot at the batch's final version exists and a new repository reads 0 events; rule 1.
Rule 6 numeric order from both the writing and a fresh repository; README expiry rule (expires_at <= now); rule 1.
Rule 7: after each ConcurrencyError the next load from the same repository reflects exactly the store and a retried command succeeds.
Rule 7: load never returns state including uncommitted events.
Rule 7: after a failed save the same repository reflects exactly the store (no phantom TransferReceived, no missing deposit); retried transfer succeeds; rule 1.
README domain rules (InsufficientFunds on available incl. fee, AccountNotFound before any write, HoldNotFound, expires_at <= now) remain in force; rule 1.
README: amounts accept str/int/Decimal (float TypeError), two decimal places, positive (fees may be zero; FeeCharged only when fee > 0).
Rule 1 agreement for arbitrary command sequences across three service instances with conflicting saves (rules 5-8), snapshot_every=1.
Rule 1 agreement for arbitrary command sequences, snapshot_every=2.
Rule 1 agreement for arbitrary command sequences, snapshot_every=3.
Rule 1 agreement for arbitrary command sequences, snapshot_every=5.
Rule 1 agreement for arbitrary command sequences, snapshot_every=7.
